name: Light Moorish Cavalry

abilities.name: Wedge
abilities.text: The unit moves into a wedge-shaped attack formation.

abilities.name: Frenzy
abilities.text: Improves a unit's attack capabilities for an extended period of time.

attributes.name: Resistant to Fatigue
attributes.text: Fatigue has less of an effect on this unit.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

attributes.name: Scare (everyone)
attributes.text: This unit frightens all enemy units.

attributes.name: Immune to Fear
attributes.text: This unit is immune to the fear effects of scary units.

short: Steeds as fast as the shifting sands, and riders just as deadly.
history: The Moors were an ancient Berber people from northern Africa. Known to the Romans as 'Mauri', the province of Mauretania was named for them. Before that, they both traded with and, at times, were 'friends' - clients - of Rome. Yet Mauri history goes back a lot further; they were known to be trading partners of Carthage at the height of the dead city-state's mercantile power. During the 3rd century AD the Mauri even produced two important bishops, one of whom went on to become St Augustine. At the time of the Vandal conquest of Roman Africa many of the Mauri were fully-integrated into Roman society. However, some continued to live in the desert, on the borders of the Roman world and in the tribal manner. Their traditional methods of fighting kept the Vandals from completely subjugating the region, much of which remained in Mauri hands until the Islamic conquest of the 7th century.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
